newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FHTK Holdings gets nod for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: FHTK Holdings gets nod for Singapore listing.

text.p: FHTK Holdings Pte Ltd, a supplier of fruits and vegetables, said on Friday it had received in-principle approval to list on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
A company statement gave no details of the listing but some dealers said the initial public offering was likely to be held in early January.
The group's operations range from sourcing, processing, packaging, cold storage, manufacturing, marketing to distribution.
It also has investments in shipping, hotel operations and property development.
The group's pre-tax profit grew to S$10.7 million in 1996 from S$3.8 million in 1992 while turnover rose to S$145.3 million from S$85.2 million during the same period.
